releaseNotes:
Feature: Telegram Plan Build button implements the plan like Cursor IDE
Feature: /plans catalog with dated .cursor/plans files, gitignore, Get/Build/Delete
Feature: Cursor disk cleanup (Safe/Aggressive) in Settings AI agent and Telegram /cursorcache
Fix: Telegram project switch opens Deploy instead of a black empty frame
Fix: Get MD binds to this turn's plan file (not an older last plan)
Fix: Plan MD upload uses a clean ASCII .md filename
Fix: Plan buttons survive app restart (no more expired callbacks)
